{{Quote|We need legislation to defend the displaced citizens, to protect our soldiers from feeling there is no future beyond their warfare, and we must open channels through diplomacy so that we can end this war. I know that there are those among the Separatists who would end this conflict, and I know that there are those individuals in the galaxy who would seek to promote fear and spread chaos. To those who act as agents of chaos, I say this: I stand resolute and unyielding. And if you strike my voice down, know that a chorus of thousands shall rise up in its place, for you have no dominion over the righteous. We are the defenders of truth.|Senator Amidala's keynote address|<ref name="Assassin (episode)">{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Alderaan Conference on the Clone War Refugee Crisis''' was led by [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was called to address the growing concern over refugees generated by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was hosted on the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by Organa, the planet's [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]]. It was at the conference that [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] chose to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Senator Amidala. Sing was hired by [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], who wanted revenge for his Republic [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|imprisonment]], but her assassination attempt was thwarted by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and the senator herself.
